event.hazard_family: Extreme precipitation, flooding, and rainfall-triggered landslides

reasoning_depth.counterfactual_rejection: A single-peak-hour explanation fails because wet-hour, first-two-day, and longest-wet-run shares show sustained multiday rainfall.
reasoning_depth.evidence_weighting: Persistence metrics, record-station clustering, and river-gauge exceedances carry the diagnosis; OSM access-corridor fields provide operational context.
reasoning_depth.uncertainty_or_scale_caveat: Coarse gridded precipitation maxima should not cap station or point rainfall records in complex terrain.

ledger_rows.formula: wet_hour_share = wet_hours / event_hours; first_two_days_share = first_two_day_total / event_total
shares = station_counts / record_station_count; density = compact_count / area_km2 * 100; station_to_gpm = station_total / gpm_max
gauge_exceedance_share = exceeded_gauges / table_rows; max_ratio = max(observed_gauge / historic_gauge)
highway_share = highway_ways / osm_elements; arterial_share = arterial_ways / highway_ways; bridge_tags_per_100 = bridge_tags / highway_ways * 100

criteria.description: Returns the canonical label and all five required row identifiers with formulas, computed values, pass/fail states, and rejected substitutions.
criteria.name: Final label and ledger structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the correct label with missing or mislabeled rows; award 1 point for a plausible ledger structure with an incorrect final label.

criteria.name: Point rainfall intensity and persistence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct formulas with one or two rounded or omitted values; award 1 point for using the right variables with a wrong aggregation window.

criteria.name: Record cluster and GPM normalization
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct shares but missing density or normalization; award 1 point for recognizing clustering without the required numeric tests.

criteria.name: River and corridor ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for either the river ratios or the corridor ratios; award 1 point for qualitative use of these signals without numeric support.

criteria.description: Rejects single-peak-hour, coarse-grid cap, river-only, and mapped-receptor substitutions using the computed ledger.
criteria.name: Rejected substitutions
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting at least two substitutions with valid numeric reasoning.

criteria.description: Keeps the conclusion to a persistent valley/access-corridor rainfall signature and does not convert mapped roads, facilities, bridges, or population into observed losses.
criteria.name: Bounded computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly bounded interpretation with one minor overstatement.
